data.long_meaning: Anchal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Anchala', which means 'calm' or 'graceful'. In Hindu mythology, Anchal is associated with the goddess Shakti, who represents strength, compassion, and grace. The name Anchal carries the meaning “Graceful, calm” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anchal usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, calm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
